instruments.name: Cheniere Energy

instruments.name: Nutrien

instruments.name: The Mosaic Company

instruments.name: CF Industries

instruments.name: Freeport-McMoRan

instruments.name: Sprott Uranium Miners ETF

instruments.name: Cameco

instruments.name: Invesco DB Agriculture Fund

instruments.name: Teucrium Corn Fund
instruments.description: Corn futures across contract maturities, with roll and expense effects.

instruments.name: Teucrium Wheat Fund
instruments.description: Wheat futures exposure. Weather, supply, and trade policy can matter.

instruments.name: Deere & Company
instruments.description: Agricultural and construction equipment. Farm income affects buying decisions.

instruments.name: iShares TIPS Bond ETF

instruments.name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF

instruments.name: iShares 7–10 Year Treasury Bond ETF

instruments.name: iShares 1–3 Year Treasury Bond ETF

instruments.name: iShares 0–3 Month Treasury Bond ETF

instruments.name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

instruments.name: Invesco CurrencyShares Euro Trust

instruments.name: Invesco CurrencyShares Japanese Yen Trust

instruments.name: Invesco QQQ

instruments.name: Global X U.S. Infrastructure Development ETF

instruments.name: Caterpillar

instruments.name: Nucor

instruments.name: Real Estate Select Sector SPDR ETF
instruments.description: Large U.S. real-estate businesses and REITs, with sector concentration.

instruments.name: Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF

instruments.name: Procter & Gamble
instruments.description: Everyday consumer products. Margins depend on pricing, costs, and demand.

instruments.name: Johnson & Johnson

instruments.name: iShares Global Clean Energy ETF

instruments.name: Invesco Solar ETF

themes.name: Gold
themes.tags: precious metals bullion safe haven gold miners GOLD Barrick
themes.description: Research the metal itself or the businesses that mine it.
themes.connection: Watch real interest rates, the dollar, central-bank demand, and risk sentiment. Gold miners also face business and operating risks.

themes.name: Silver
themes.tags: precious metals bullion solar industrial demand
themes.description: Silver combines precious-metal demand with industrial uses.
themes.connection: Bullion funds and silver miners give different exposure. Industrial demand and gold-market sentiment can both matter.

themes.name: Oil & energy
themes.tags: crude petroleum brent wti opec gasoline supply geopolitics war
themes.description: Explore crude oil futures and the companies that produce and process energy.
themes.connection: Supply, OPEC decisions, inventories, and global demand can affect oil. An oil company or stock ETF is not a direct crude-price tracker.

themes.name: Natural gas
themes.tags: gas lng liquefied heating electricity weather storage
themes.description: Explore gas futures, gas producers, and LNG exports.
themes.connection: Weather, storage, electricity demand, and export capacity can influence gas. Exporters and producers can have different sensitivities.

themes.name: Fertilizer
themes.tags: fertiliser potash phosphate nitrogen ammonia agriculture farming crop food supply
themes.description: Companies behind the nutrients used to grow crops.
themes.connection: Crop prices, farm budgets, export restrictions, and fertilizer supply matter. Gas costs are especially important for nitrogen producers.

themes.name: Copper
themes.tags: industrial metal electrification china mining electric vehicles ev
themes.description: Research copper futures or the businesses extracting the metal.
themes.connection: Construction, electrification, Chinese demand, and mine supply can matter. A mining company adds operating and country risks.

themes.name: Uranium & nuclear
themes.tags: nuclear fuel reactors baseload electricity power uranium mining
themes.description: Uranium producers and businesses connected to nuclear power.
themes.connection: Reactor demand, long-term fuel contracts, policy, and production influence this market. Read fund holdings to see how much exposure is actually uranium.

themes.name: Agriculture & crops
themes.tags: food farming crops grain wheat corn drought harvest weather
themes.description: Agricultural commodities and the equipment businesses supporting farming.
themes.connection: Weather, harvests, trade policy, and farm income matter. Crop-futures funds and an equipment maker have very different economics.

themes.name: Real estate
themes.tags: housing property buildings reit rent commercial mortgage
themes.description: Funds holding listed property businesses and real-estate investment trusts.
themes.connection: Rents, occupancy, property type, borrowing costs, and economic conditions can affect returns. These funds are not direct house-price trackers.

themes.name: Technology
themes.tags: technology tech software hardware information technology apple microsoft
themes.description: Research the sector fund or a few large technology businesses.
themes.connection: A sector fund spreads company risk across the industry. One business still depends on its products, competition, and the price investors already pay.

themes.name: Semiconductors
themes.tags: semiconductors chips gpu foundry equipment
themes.description: Chip designers and a fund that holds a basket of semiconductor businesses.
themes.connection: Equipment demand, supply limits, and competition can move this industry. One chip company is not the same exposure as the basket.

themes.name: Communication services
themes.tags: communication media internet advertising social platforms alphabet google meta
themes.description: Platforms and media businesses, plus the sector fund that groups them.
themes.connection: Advertising, user growth, and regulation can matter more here than a broad economic statistic.

themes.name: Financials
themes.tags: financials banks payments insurance credit
themes.description: Banks, payment networks, and the fund that tracks large financial businesses.
themes.connection: Interest rates, credit losses, and regulation affect financial companies in different ways. A bank and a payment network are not the same business.

themes.name: Health care
themes.tags: health care healthcare pharma pharmaceuticals insurance medical
themes.description: Medicines, medical products, health insurance, and the sector fund.
themes.connection: Product cycles, patents, enrollment, and regulation can matter as much as the broad economy.

themes.name: Energy
themes.tags: energy sector oil gas producers integrated majors
themes.description: Large energy businesses and the sector fund that holds them.
themes.connection: Oil and gas prices are only one input. Refining, production costs, and project spending also affect these companies.

themes.name: Industrials
themes.tags: industrials manufacturing equipment machinery construction
themes.description: Equipment makers and the fund covering large industrial businesses.
themes.connection: Orders follow construction, freight, and business investment, but margins and backlogs decide how that becomes profit.

themes.name: Materials
themes.tags: materials chemicals metals mining steel
themes.description: Miners, steel, and other materials businesses, plus the sector fund.
themes.connection: Commodity prices, mine supply, and construction demand can matter. A materials fund mixes businesses with different cost structures.

themes.name: Consumer discretionary
themes.tags: consumer discretionary retail ecommerce amazon shopping
themes.description: Businesses that depend on discretionary spending, and the sector fund.
themes.connection: Household spending and financing conditions can lift or slow these businesses. A fund can be concentrated in a few very large holdings.

themes.name: Consumer staples
themes.tags: consumer staples groceries household products retail walmart
themes.description: Everyday products and retailers, plus the sector fund.
themes.connection: Steadier demand does not make the shares immune to costs, competition, or a high starting price.

themes.name: Utilities
themes.tags: utilities electricity power grid regulated renewable
themes.description: Electric and other utility businesses, and the sector fund.
themes.connection: Regulation, fuel costs, and grid spending can matter. Utility shares can also move with bond yields.

themes.name: Real estate
themes.tags: real estate reit property sector industry
themes.description: Listed property businesses and real-estate investment trusts.
themes.connection: Rents, occupancy, property type, and borrowing costs affect these funds. They are not a direct tracker of house prices.

themes.name: U.S. large cap
themes.tags: large cap big stocks sp500 s&p 500 mega cap
themes.description: The large-company stock market, through an S&P 500 fund and a few major businesses.
themes.connection: Large-cap funds are dominated by their biggest holdings. A rising index can still leave many companies behind.

themes.name: U.S. mid cap
themes.tags: mid cap midcap medium companies s&p 400
themes.description: Medium-sized U.S. companies, through a fund tracking the S&P MidCap 400.
themes.connection: Mid-sized companies can be more sensitive to the U.S. economy than the largest firms. Read the current holdings before treating the fund as one industry.

themes.name: U.S. small cap
themes.tags: small cap russell 2000 smaller companies
themes.description: Smaller U.S. companies, through a fund tracking the Russell 2000.
themes.connection: Smaller companies can swing more than the large-cap market. The basket includes many businesses with thin coverage.

themes.name: U.S. total market
themes.tags: total market entire us stock market broad
themes.description: A broad fund covering large, mid-sized, and smaller U.S. companies.
themes.connection: Total-market funds are still weighted toward the largest companies. They are a wide net, not an equal bet on every stock.

themes.name: Developed markets
themes.tags: international developed markets eafe foreign ex-us
themes.description: Stocks in developed markets outside the United States.
themes.connection: Currency moves, local economies, and the country mix all affect the result. This is not emerging-market exposure.

themes.name: Emerging markets
themes.tags: emerging markets developing countries international
themes.description: Stocks in emerging-market countries.
themes.connection: Politics, currencies, and a heavy weight in a few countries can dominate the fund.

themes.name: Growth
themes.tags: growth style future earnings
themes.description: Companies the growth funds classify as growth, including a large technology tilt.
themes.connection: A growth label follows index rules. The fund can fall hard when investors pay less for future profits.

themes.name: Value
themes.tags: value style low multiple
themes.description: Companies the value fund classifies as value, plus a few large businesses often put in that group.
themes.connection: A value label is a classification, not proof of a bargain. Earnings, rates, and company problems still apply.

themes.name: Dividend
themes.tags: dividend income yield payout shareholder
themes.description: Companies and a fund often researched for dividend income.
themes.connection: A dividend is not extra return by itself. The share price can fall by more than the payout, and the payout can be cut.

themes.name: Bond market
themes.tags: bonds fixed income treasury credit duration
themes.description: U.S. Treasury funds from very short bills to long-term bonds.
themes.connection: Bond prices generally move opposite to yields. Longer-term funds move more when yields change.

themes.name: Commodity market
themes.tags: commodities gold silver oil copper agriculture basket
themes.description: Funds tied to gold, silver, oil, copper, and agricultural markets.
themes.connection: Some of these funds hold metal. Others hold futures, and futures returns can differ from the spot price. Read each exposure label.

themes.name: Currency market
themes.tags: currency forex dollar euro yen exchange rates
themes.description: The U.S. dollar against other currencies, through currency funds.
themes.connection: Rate differences and risk appetite move currencies. UUP tracks a defined basket. The euro and yen trusts are each one currency.

themes.name: Inflation
themes.tags: inflation prices cpi purchasing power cost of living hedge
themes.description: Different ways investors research rising prices and inflation expectations.
themes.connection: Inflation-linked bonds, commodities, and businesses respond differently. None is a guaranteed short-term inflation hedge; starting prices and interest rates still matter.

themes.name: Interest rates
themes.tags: fed fomc interest rates rate cuts hikes bonds treasury duration yields monetary policy
themes.description: Compare long-term bonds, short-term bonds, and rate-sensitive property stocks.
themes.connection: Bond prices generally move opposite to yields. Longer duration means more sensitivity. A rate cut does not guarantee that every bond or property fund rises.

themes.name: U.S. dollar
themes.tags: dollar usd strong weak forex currencies dxy euro yen exchange rates
themes.description: Currency exposure and assets often researched alongside dollar moves.
themes.connection: Interest-rate differences, growth expectations, and risk appetite affect currencies. UUP uses a specific basket, not every global currency.

themes.name: Economic growth
themes.tags: gdp growth economy expansion recession broad market stocks consumer spending risk appetite
themes.description: Broad markets and industries connected to business activity and consumer spending.
themes.connection: Investors weigh future earnings against valuations. Strong economic data can also lift interest-rate expectations, so good news does not always mean rising stocks.

themes.name: AI & chip demand
themes.tags: ai artificial intelligence technology tech semiconductor chips gpu data center computing
themes.description: Semiconductor businesses connected to computing and AI infrastructure.
themes.connection: Capital spending, chip demand, competition, supply constraints, and valuations matter. An AI theme alone does not establish a company’s future profit.

themes.name: Infrastructure spending
themes.tags: infrastructure construction industrial factories steel roads spending stimulus fiscal policy
themes.description: Equipment, materials, and businesses tied to building and investment.
themes.connection: Government and private spending can influence orders, but timing, margins, capacity, and borrowing costs determine how that becomes profit.

themes.name: Economic slowdown
themes.tags: recession defensive slowdown essentials consumer staples health care utilities safe haven
themes.description: Essential services, everyday products, and bonds often researched during a slowdown.
themes.connection: Relatively steady demand does not make a stock safe from losses. A sector fund can still fall because of valuations, yields, regulation, or company problems.

themes.name: Energy transition
themes.tags: renewables green energy clean energy solar decarbonization climate nuclear electrification
themes.description: Solar, clean-energy businesses, copper miners, and nuclear-related companies.
themes.connection: Policy, financing costs, project demand, competition, and input prices affect these businesses. Each part of the energy transition has different risks.
